description: Rising column of billowing smoke with three turbulence scales. Asymmetric breakup, density gradient, and sky dissipation.

orchestration_stages.label: Burn Source Volume
orchestration_stages.description: Define the temperature and density source for smoke generation.
orchestration_hints: Temperature source: 400–800K at base. Smoke emits below 300K.
artistic_constraints: Source volume radius drives column diameter. 0.5–3.0m radius.

orchestration_stages.label: Initial Column Rise
orchestration_stages.description: Simulate initial upward momentum of smoke column.
orchestration_hints: Column must narrow slightly as it rises 2–5m.
artistic_constraints: Velocity must not be constant — slight acceleration as heat pushes up.
Dark dense smoke at base — lighter sparse at 5m height.

orchestration_stages.label: Multi-Scale Turbulence
orchestration_stages.description: Apply three turbulence frequency layers for organic breakup.
artistic_constraints: All three turbulence layers required — no exceptions.

orchestration_stages.label: Breakup and Asymmetry
orchestration_stages.description: Add directional wind and asymmetric variation to prevent uniform column.
orchestration_hints: Add wind field: 0.5–2 m/s in consistent horizontal direction.
Wind causes column to lean — more cinematic than vertical.
Add wind variation over time — gusts every 24–48 frames.
artistic_constraints: Column must lean in wind direction above 10m height.
No two identical frames — variation must be constant.
Periodic large billow release every 30–60 frames.

orchestration_stages.label: Sky Dissipation
orchestration_stages.description: Control how smoke dissipates at upper altitude — gradual fade to transparent.
artistic_constraints: Density must reach zero by maximum altitude.
Dissipation must be gradual — not sharp cutoff.
Wisps and tendrils at upper edge — not a uniform cap.

review_expectations.column_shape: Pinch at base, billow outward, lean in wind. Not straight vertical cylinder.
review_expectations.turbulence: Three scales visible. Micro, mid, macro all contribute.
review_expectations.asymmetry: Column leans. Billows irregular. No two frames identical.
review_expectations.density_gradient: Dark dense base, lighter transparent top.
review_expectations.dissipation: Wisps at top — gradual fade. No hard cap.
